code_blocks.content:
SEO Gap Brief Builder

Turn a rough keyword, audience, angle, and competitor notes into editable cards for content gaps, outline angles, metadata, FAQs, claim checks, and a copy-ready brief.

Inputs Gap map Outline Titles/meta FAQs Claims Brief

Inputs

Paste messy notes. The tool uses local heuristics only. No network calls.

0 gap cards
0 brief depth
0 claims to verify

Gap-map cards

Edit the cards directly. Tap chips to change priority.

Outline ideas

Use these as H2/H3 candidates or content modules.

Title and meta options

Title length and meta length are estimated while you edit.

FAQ prompts

Good for PAA-style questions, support objections, and internal-link targets.

Claims checklist

Use this to prevent thin, unsupported, or risky copy.

Copyable content brief

Generated from your current cards and edits.

Backup and restore

Export saves your current inputs and editable cards as JSON.
